lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Linear series of approximately 6-8 high-luminance circular clusters visible along the mid-lateral line, with inter-spot spacing increasing as the trajectory approaches the caudal peduncle.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Prominent horizontal linear feature extending from the mid-frame toward the posterior, characterized by a sharp luminance boundary between the patterned dorsal surface and the shaded ventral region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large semicircular notch or missing tissue on the trailing edge of the visible ventral/pelvic fin; high-luminance focal marker identified by an external white graphical arrow.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a large cluster of attendant teleost fish (remoras) concentrated along the ventral midline and lower flank.
